text:
riya: Quick check on bulk edit roles modal: we need a consistent validation pattern when admins paste CSVs vs filling fields. Two calls: inline field errors vs top summary; and delete-role confirmation for role groups (typed vs checkbox vs undo). Thoughts?
dan: For pasted CSVs we should always show a top summary with counts (errors: 3, warnings: 2) and anchor links to the rows. Inline per-field errors make sense when editing single rows.
otis: Agree. Summary should show a short actionable list: e.g., "Row 4: invalid email (jump)". Anchors must set focus to the error cell in the grid.
maya: UX nit: required markers in table columns are tricky. Suggest column headers show a small asterisk and we surface the full "Required" label in a tooltip or on first-run hint. Avoid repeating "Required" per cell.
qa-lead: Test coverage ask: e2e for keyboard nav in the table, focus moves from summary item to cell, screenreader announces error cell and content. Also test pasted CSV that triggers server-side validation (duplicate role name).
a11y-bot: Accessibility guidance: 1) summary region use role="status" with aria-live="polite" for non-blocking issues, use aria-live="assertive" for blocking submit failures; 2) table cells with errors need aria-describedby pointing to the error text; 3) required markers need accessible names (sr-only label or aria-label) not only color.
riya: For delete-role-group: ops prefers typed-confirm for any group with >5 members. Design wants a lower-friction default. Proposal: default = checkbox + bold warning; if group size > 5 or has external access, require typed-confirm.
dan: Also add a 3s countdown on the final confirm button for large groups, with an explicit undo toast for 10s after delete. Telemetry: record confirm_type and whether undo used.
otis: Modal semantics: use role="alertdialog" and ensure the typed-confirm input has aria-describedby referencing the danger copy. For typed-confirm exact-match, show the expected phrase in code style `Delete role-group: admins`. Truncate long names visually but include full label in aria.
maya: Microcopy: avoid scary jargon. Example: "Delete role group 'admins' — this will remove the role from 12 users. Type DELETE to confirm." Variants: `Type DELETE`, or `Type the group name`. We should test which reduces accidental deletes most.
qa-lead: E2E: typed-confirm exact-match, undo restores memberships, countdown skip respects prefers-reduced-motion, and summary anchors focus.
riya: Action items: riya -> mock CSV summary + inline-row error states; dan -> draft telemetry events and undo UX; otis -> accessibility checklist and aria id patterns; maya -> microcopy variants; qa-lead -> test matrix. I'll schedule a follow-up in 48h.
riya: Thanks all :sparkles:
